outcome: Proportion of babies with TB risk status recorded
Uptake of BCG vaccination in at-risk babies
cohort: All babies born in Grampian in 2012 and 2013.
finding: Over 95% of babies had a TB risk status recorded, and BCG vaccination uptake in at-risk babies was between 85.9% and 89.9%.
cross-section timing: Data was reviewed for babies born in 2012 and 2013, with the analysis performed prior to 2015.
